applications.proof: Mark, definition, montage background behavior, CTA hierarchy and workflow coexist without competing.
Mark and wordmark separate cleanly; definition wraps naturally; primary CTA remains thumb-reachable.
Mark works at compact size without relying on wordmark.
Framed-M silhouette remains identifiable at small scale.
Single-color path system works over video with contrast field when needed.
Mark is centered and readable without text.
Editorial serif, whitespace and framed-image grammar scale to documents.
Ink on Paper/White is primary system.
Reverse white lockup defined; signal color remains accent only.
Fragment-to-whole grid adapts to vertical crops and preserves logo clearance.

risks: Wordmark SVG depends on the approved display typeface being loaded; mark SVG is fully geometric and independent.
Montage backgrounds must be curated for narrative relationship; random collage treatment weakens the identity.
Signal gold should not become a luxury-decoration shortcut.
